name: Flood traditions
layer_note: Flood stories from cultures around the world, as presented by their sources. These are traditions, not excavated finds.

properties.name: Tupinambá flood tradition — coastal Brazil
properties.found: The channel presents a Tupinambá story of a flood covering mountains, written down by three Europeans in the 1550s, and links it to the Genesis flood.
properties.notes: Pin marks the general Rio de Janeiro coast region where the 1550s accounts were recorded.
caveats: The link to the Genesis flood is the channel’s interpretation.
The Europeans who wrote the story down may have framed it in biblical terms.
